topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I can't stop thinking about the time we spent there, the way the place felt like home. Every visit, a thread in the fabric of our days. I remember your face, lit up by more than just the warm glow of those old lamps, every time you found a new favorite dish. Now, the news sits heavy between us, unspoken but there all the same. I should have said something, should have suggested we go one last time. But the words won’t come, stuck in my throat. Maybe it’s the silence that’s louder, the things left unsaid echoing more than any words ever could.
